label: Google Drive
description: Google's cloud storage and collaboration platform, suitable for sharing documents and files with anyone inside or outside the university.

label: Microsoft OneDrive
description: University-licensed cloud storage integrated with Microsoft 365, with Princeton login required for access to sensitive content.

label: Dropbox
description: A cloud file synchronization service for easy access to and sharing of non-sensitive files from any device.

label: Box
description: A secure cloud content management platform with robust access controls, version history, and support for sensitive and confidential data.

label: Central File Server
description: University-managed departmental network storage with automated backups, high availability, and support for large numbers of files.

label: OnBase
description: An enterprise document management system for highly sensitive and regulated records, including data subject to HIPAA requirements.

label: DataSpace
description: Princeton's open-access institutional repository for sharing and preserving research outputs with the broader academic community.

label: Research Computing Storage
description: High-capacity storage tightly integrated with Princeton's HPC clusters, optimized for large datasets and computationally intensive workflows.

label: Figgy
description: Princeton University Library's digital repository for ingesting, managing, and preserving digitized manuscripts, images, and audiovisual materials for public access.

label: Tigerdata
description: Princeton's institutional research data management service for large, long-term storage of active and published research data with strong preservation and availability guarantees.
